title: Coefficient Tate twists
statement:
Fix a prime $\ell$, a finite extension $E/\Ql$ with valuation ring $\mathcal O_E$,
uniformizer $\varpi_E$, residue rings $A_{E,n}=\mathcal O_E/\varpi_E^n$ and the
algebraic closure $\Qlb$ of the global coefficient notation
[def-weil-finite-field-fiber], an integer $n\in\mathbf Z_{\geq1}$, and a scheme
$S$ on which $\ell$ is invertible. Use the small pro-etale site
[def-weil-pbc-proetale-site] of $S$, with its constant sheaves $A_S$ for a ring
$A$ and its derived categories $D(S_{\mathrm{proet}},A)$, and the derived
tensor product [def-weil-derived-tensor]. For every integer $r\geq1$, let
$\mu_{\ell^r,S}$ be the pro-etale sheaf of $\ell^r$-th roots of unity
[def-pur-roots-of-unity-sheaf],

$$
 \mu_{\ell^r,S}(U)=
 \{u\in\Gamma(U,\mathcal O_U^\times):u^{\ell^r}=1\}
 \qquad(U\to S).
$$

With transition maps $u\mapsto u^\ell$, use the finite-torsion coefficient
[def-weil-finite-torsion-constructibility] $A_{E,n}$ from the global
coefficient notation, and define, with the inverse limit of sheaves
[def-pur-sheaf-inverse-limit] and the tensor product of sheaves of modules
[def-pur-sheaf-tensor-product] over the constant sheaves $(\Zl)_S$ and
$(\mathcal O_E)_S$,

$$
  \Zl(1)_S=\varprojlim_{r\geq1}\mu_{\ell^r,S},\qquad
  \mathcal O_E(1)_S=\Zl(1)_S\otimes_{\Zl}\mathcal O_E,
$$

and

$$
  A_{E,n}(1)_S=
  \mathcal O_E(1)_S\otimes_{\mathcal O_E}A_{E,n},
 \qquad E(1)_S=\mathcal O_E(1)_S\otimes_{\mathcal O_E}E.
$$

Here $A_{E,n}(1)_S$ is a sheaf of $(A_{E,n})_S$-modules, and
$\mathcal O_E(1)_S$ is a locally free module of rank one over the completed
coefficient sheaf $\widehat{\mathcal O}_{E,S}$ with reductions $A_{E,n}(1)_S$,
lying in the derived-complete integral category $D^b_c(S,\mathcal O_E)$
[def-weil-derived-complete-integral-detailed], by
[lem-pur-twist-sheaf-locally-free]; $E(1)_S$ denotes its image in the
rationalization $D^b_c(S,E)=D^b_c(S,\mathcal O_E)[1/\varpi_E]$
[def-weil-rationalization-karoubi]. The $\Qlb$-twist is represented by $E(1)_S$
at every finite stage of the common-stage category
[def-weil-algebraically-closed-coefficients] and is compatible with scalar
extension [def-weil-rationalization-karoubi]. For each displayed coefficient
ring $\Lambda\in\{A_{E,n},\mathcal O_E,E,\Qlb\}$, let $\Lambda_S$ denote its
coefficient object on $S$: it is the finite-level constant sheaf
$(A_{E,n})_S$ for $\Lambda=A_{E,n}$, the completed coefficient sheaf
$\widehat{\mathcal O}_{E,S}$ of the completed integral construction
[def-weil-completed-integral-coefficients] for $\Lambda=\mathcal O_E$, and
the scalar extensions of these objects for $\Lambda=E,\Qlb$, with $\Qlb$
interpreted at a common finite stage. Thus, for each coefficient ring,
$\Lambda(1)_S$ is respectively the finite-level object $A_{E,n}(1)_S$, the
integral object $\mathcal O_E(1)_S$, the rational object $E(1)_S$, or its
common-stage $\Qlb$-extension. Define the twist for every $m\in\mathbf Z$ by

$$
 \Lambda(m):=
 \begin{cases}
   \Lambda_S,&m=0,\\
   \Lambda(1)_S^{\otimes_{\Lambda_S}m},&m>0,\\
   \operatorname{Hom}_{\Lambda_S}\bigl(\Lambda(-m),\Lambda_S\bigr),&m<0,
 \end{cases}
$$

where $\Lambda(1)_S^{\otimes_{\Lambda_S}m}$ is the $m$-fold tensor power of
sheaves of $\Lambda_S$-modules [def-pur-sheaf-tensor-product] and
$\operatorname{Hom}_{\Lambda_S}(-,\Lambda_S)$ is the sheaf Hom
[def-pur-sheaf-hom]; for $\Lambda\in\{E,\Qlb\}$ the three cases are formed on
the integral representative, so that $E(m)$ is the image of $\mathcal O_E(m)$
in $D^b_c(S,E)$ and $\Qlb(m)$ its common-stage extension. For every
$m\in\mathbf Z$ and every $K\in D(S_{\mathrm{proet}},\Lambda)$ (for
$\Lambda\in\{E,\Qlb\}$, every $K\in D^b_c(S,\Lambda)$, the only categories
defined at these coefficients, the twist being formed on an integral
representative), set

$$
 K(m)=K\otimes^L_{\Lambda_S}\Lambda(m).
$$

split_report.summary: Checked the statement against the master blueprint node (verbatim; the node has no slopmaster2 copy, no Lean on either branch). Kept every defined object and the displayed formulas, and added the bracketed names of the notions each is built from: the ℓ-adic coefficient notation Z_ℓ, O_E, ϖ_E, A_{E,n}, Q̄_ℓ (def-weil-finite-field-fiber), the pro-etale site with its constant sheaves A_S and categories D(S_proet, A) (def-weil-pbc-proetale-site), the pro-etale sheaf μ_{ℓ^r,S} with its transition maps (new node def-pur-roots-of-unity-sheaf, unsplit, from Stacks 03PK/040M/03O3), the inverse limit of sheaves (new leaf def-pur-sheaf-inverse-limit, Mathlib SheafOfModules.hasLimitsOfShape), the underived tensor product, change of rings and tensor powers of sheaves of modules (new leaf def-pur-sheaf-tensor-product, Mathlib PresheafOfModules.Monoidal + sheafification), the sheaf Hom (new node def-pur-sheaf-hom, unsplit, Stacks 04TT/03EM), the completed coefficient sheaf Ô_{E,S} (def-weil-completed-integral-coefficients, which constructs it; the blueprint pointed for it to def-weil-derived-complete-integral-detailed, which defines the category D^b_c(S,O_E) and is now cited for that), the rationalization and scalar extension (def-weil-rationalization-karoubi) and the common-stage Q̄_ℓ category (def-weil-algebraically-closed-coefficients). The definition of E(1)_S as an object of D^b_c(S,E) presupposes that O_E(1)_S lies in D^b_c(S,O_E); this presupposition, with the local freeness of rank one of μ_{ℓ^r,S}, Z_ℓ(1)_S and O_E(1)_S that makes the tensor-power and Hom cases meaningful, is the new statement node lem-pur-twist-sheaf-locally-free (unsplit), cited in the statement. Clarified, without changing any formula, that E(1)_S and E(m) are the images of the integral objects in the rationalization and that for Λ = E, Q̄_ℓ the complex K ranges over D^b_c(S,Λ), the only categories the blueprint defines at field coefficients (the blueprint writes D(S_proet, Λ) for all four Λ). Removed def-weil-finite-tor-amplitude from stmt_deps: the statement uses nothing of it (the import had flagged it as uses_not_cited). Mathlib searched for the twist itself: the pro-etale site and the ℓ-adic sheaf ℤ_[ℓ] exist (AlgebraicGeometry/Sites/Proetale.lean, ElladicCohomology.lean), no twist. blueprint_*, import_flags, uses_not_cited and lean_audit untouched.
